description: Luminous Ampbox AB24060 Gel Battery for Home, Office & Shops | Tall Tubular Battery | 4hr Backup | Maintenance Free | German Technology | Durable & Reliable | 60 Months Warranty by Luminous | Tall Tubular Battery, 4hr Backup, Maintenance Free, German Technology, 60 Months Warranty - Distributed/Packaged by Luminous. Product Details: Maintenance-Free Operation: AmpBox requires no water top-ups, providing hassle-free, long-lasting power without extra service. Eco-Friendly & Safe: Made from 98% recyclable materials, AmpBox uses spill-proof GelSync technology to prevent hazardous gassing, ensuring safety during use and transport, while also minimizing its environmental impact. Custom Backup Time Options: Choose from 3hr/4hr/5hr/6hr backup time variants, tested with a 400W load (e.g., 5 LED bulbs, 1 TV, 2 fans, 1 refrigerator) for consistent performance based on your power needs. Universal Inverter Compatibility: Works with most inverter brand or type, making it ideal for home, office, or commercial use without compatibility concerns. Extreme Temperature Performance: Delivers reliable power even in harsh conditions, functioning smoothly from -15°C to 50°C, whether in freezing cold or intense heat. 60-Month Warranty: Includes a comprehensive 36-month full warranty followed by an additional 24-month pro-rata warranty, ensuring long-term reliability and pleasure for your investment.
